narrative.overview:
AIMS is a ZKTeco distributor you can walk into, and the interface behaves like its Deira showroom. The page is a light showroom floor in barely-green greys. Real products stand on white lifted cards like display plinths, each named by its model code. AIMS green is the sign over the door: it marks what you can act on and almost nothing else. When the story needs drama, the page turns to the showroom after hours: deep night-green surfaces where lime becomes the light at the reader, the one moment a credential is accepted.

Density follows the visitor. Marketing surfaces are spacious, with one idea per screen and the product shown big. The catalogue, compare and quote surfaces are exact and Swiss: tabular figures, hairlines, mono model codes, nothing decorative between the buyer and the spec. Motion exists only to show how access and attendance work (credentials reaching a reader, a door kit assembling, a punch becoming a timesheet) or to answer a pointer.

Rejected, on the evidence of aimsuae.me and NUZON: a manufacturer-branded header, stock "consulting" and "ACCESS GRANTED" photographs, carousels, the same green button repeated four times in a row, a secondary blue, glassmorphism, blobs and burgundy ribbons.
keyCharacteristics: Light showroom floor, white lifted product cards, real cut-outs on white.
One action colour (AIMS green); lime only as light, never as body text on light surfaces.
Night-green sections for the after-hours moments; daylight for the catalogue.
Model codes in IBM Plex Mono as the system's signature.
Inter throughout, heavy-ish display weights (650–680), sentence case.
Pill controls, gently rounded cards, hairline borders.

rules.name: The One Sign Rule
rules.body: AIMS Green marks what can be acted on and nothing decorative. If something green can't be clicked, selected or read as a state, it shouldn't be green.

rules.name: The Lime Is Light Rule
rules.body: Lime is a light source, not a paint: wordmark stop, signal pulses, the reader LED, and text only on night surfaces. Never a fill behind dark text on light pages.

rules.name: The No Second Accent Rule
rules.body: No blue, no violet, no burgundy. aimsuae.me's secondary blue was considered and rejected: it competes with green as the clickable colour.

rules.name: The Datasheet Rule
rules.body: Every model code is in IBM Plex Mono and stays left-to-right inside Arabic. Quantities, counts and specs use tabular figures; units take a space ("12 V DC", "280 kg").

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Sentence case everywhere except the brand line. No trailing periods on buttons and labels.

rules.name: The Plinth Rule
rules.body: A card that holds a product or a link sits on a resting shadow and lifts 2px with the lifted shadow on hover. Bands, tables and text never cast shadows.

dos: **Do** show real AIMS product cut-outs on white, big and whole, named by their model codes in mono.
**Do** keep AIMS Green (#26703a) for actions and selection only, and lime for light and signal only.
**Do** lift linked cards: hairline + resting shadow at rest, 2px rise with the lifted shadow on hover.
**Do** switch to night-green surfaces (#0a1a10 family) for a section that tells a story, and back to the showroom floor for the catalogue.
**Do** keep every text pair at 4.5:1 or better, including lime and muted text on night surfaces.
**Do** keep 44px touch targets and the shared container's two content edges on every section.
donts: **Don't** put a manufacturer's logo in the header or hero; ZKTeco logos only identify products.
**Don't** use a secondary blue, violet or burgundy, or gradients as decoration on light surfaces.
**Don't** use stock "consulting", hologram or "ACCESS GRANTED" imagery, glassmorphism, blobs or carousels.
**Don't** repeat the same filled green button across a row of cards; a card's action is a text link.
**Don't** set lime as text on light surfaces (2.29:1) or use ink-300 for information.
**Don't** caption images; licence credits go in one footer line.
